full_name: IFAC World Congress (World Congress of the International Federation of Automatic Control)
organizer: International Federation of Automatic Control (IFAC), with a national member organization as host (e.g., ICROS/Korea for 2026)

submission.type: full paper (regular/survey papers, 6 pages in IFAC-PapersOnLine; invited sessions/open invited tracks; journal option; late-breaking/discussion papers not in proceedings)
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Late October to early December of the year before the congress (2017: Nov 11, 2016; 2020: Oct 31, 2019; 2023: Oct 31, 2022; 2026: Dec 5, 2025)
submission.typical_final_deadline: March-May of the congress year (2026: May 19, 2026; 2017: Apr 10, 2017)
submission.notes: No separate abstract stage. 'abstract_deadline' holds the regular/invited paper submission deadline (final value after extensions where known). IFAC 2026 dates: submission site opened Jun 16, 2025; invited session proposals Oct 9, 2025; journal option Nov 2, 2025; regular/survey/demo papers Nov 26 -> Dec 5, 2025 ('new deadline (FIRM!)'); late-breaking Feb 28, 2026; notification Apr 15, 2026; final paper May 19, 2026.

notes: Triennial; only the 2017, 2020, 2023, 2026 congresses fall in 2015+, plus announced 2029 (Amsterdam) and 2032 (Honolulu, no dates). 2026 (23rd) Busan congress is over (Aug 23-28, 2026; 3,898 regular/invited papers submitted per IFAC Dec 2025 newsletter). Next: 24th IFAC World Congress, Amsterdam, July 8-13, 2029, Amsterdam RAI (General Chairs Ming Cao and Manuel Mazo per IFAC); its paper deadline is NOT yet published - by past pattern it would be roughly Oct-Dec 2028 (inference only). 2020 congress was entirely virtual (organizer site says congress week July 11-17; VDI/VDE hosted July 12-17); its Oct 31, 2019 deadline comes from an IFAC President's column (Aug 2019), not a congress page. 2023 deadline Oct 31, 2022 from IFAC newsletter / 2nd CFP (not confirmed on ifac2023.org; possible extension not checked). 2017 deadline extended Oct 31 -> Nov 8 -> Nov 11, 2016. 2017 venue (Toulouse congress centre) not verified -> null. 2014 Cape Town congress is outside the 2015+ window.
